premise: I get hit by a truck and wake up in a fantasy world as a hero with an overpowered cheat skill.

draft.premise: I get hit by a truck and wake up in a fantasy world as a hero with an overpowered cheat skill.

world.title: Rebirth of the Cheat Hero
world.era: Aethelgard: a medieval realm of swords, magic, and status screens

extraordinary.reach: Mages can summon elemental fire, heal minor wounds, or erect defensive barriers.
All living beings possess an interface that displays their attributes, skills, and combat rank.

rules.text: Every living being's potential and growth are governed by the Status System, visible through an interface.
Only summoned beings from other worlds possess 'cheat skills' that completely ignore the standard laws of magic.
Casting magical spells consumes mana, which requires rest, meditation, or special potions to replenish.

peoples.name: Human
peoples.description: The dominant inhabitants of Solaria, adaptable and governed by the Status System.
peoples.culture: Structured feudal society centered around magic, chivalry, and the Royal Family.

creatures.name: Demon Beast
creatures.description: Corrupted predators born from wild magic.

nature: Magic flows like underground rivers, pooling in high-concentration zones known as mana veins.

rungs.name: F-Rank
rungs.description: Fresh novices who struggle with basic pests and slimes.

rungs.name: D-Rank
rungs.description: Capable of handling wild predators and minor demon beasts.

rungs.name: C-Rank
rungs.description: Standard professionals; the backbone of local defence forces.

rungs.name: B-Rank
rungs.description: Elites who can take down formidable monsters single-handedly.

rungs.name: A-Rank
rungs.description: Masters whose presence can turn the tide of a local battle.

rungs.name: S-Rank
rungs.description: Living legends of unmatched combat capability.

travel.description: Travel is conducted on foot, by horse-drawn carriage, or via rare, expensive magical teleportation gates.

medicine.healing: Minor injuries can be healed instantly with holy magic; lost limbs require rare high-tier elixirs.

laws.text: All registered adventurers must contribute ten percent of their dungeon earnings to the local crown representative.

norms: Viewing another person's status screen without their explicit permission is considered a grave breach of privacy and etiquette.

places.name: Solaria Capital
places.description: A bustling metropolis protected by high stone walls and ancient runic barriers.

places.name: Solaria Royal Castle
places.description: A grand white-stone castle that towers over the capital city.

places.name: The Chamber of Rebirth
places.description: A secure, subterranean ritual hall lined with glowing mana crystals and gold runes.

places.name: The Whispering Woods
places.description: A vast, ancient forest thick with dense foliage and aggressive demon beasts.

factions.name: Kingdom of Solaria
factions.description: The proud human realm currently besieged by demon encroachers.
factions.goal: Defeat the Demon Lord and secure human survival.
factions.methods: Summoning otherworldly heroes to bypass magic limitations.
factions.strength: An army of disciplined knights and high-tier court mages.

npcs.name: Princess Elara Solaria
npcs.description: A determined royal princess carrying the heavy burden of her kingdom's survival.
npcs.appearance: Delicate features, long silver hair tied in a practical braid, and deep blue ceremonial robes.

wants: A hero capable of turning the tide against the demon vanguard.
temperament.voice: Formal, clear, and slightly strained by heavy responsibility.

traits.name: Royal Grace
traits.description: Naturally commands attention and respect when speaking.

agenda.goal: Convince the summoned hero to fight Solaria's enemies.
agenda.method: Offering royal resources, titles, and emotional appeals.
agenda.secret: She used her own life force as a catalyst for the summoning ritual.

secrets: The ritual has shortened her life unless she is cured with divine elixirs.

npcs.name: Grand Mage Valerius
npcs.description: An aging, sharp-tongued court wizard who values cold facts and results above all else.
npcs.appearance: Wrinkled skin, sharp gray eyes, wearing dark violet robes adorned with starry constellations.

wants: To ensure the newly summoned hero's powers are stable and controllable.

traits.name: Mana Sensitivity
traits.description: Can immediately spot high-density mana surges in his vicinity.

agenda.goal: Test the limits of the hero's cheat skill to ensure it poses no threat to the crown.
agenda.method: Using diagnostic magic and structured combat trials.
agenda.secret: He intends to bind the hero to an oath of non-aggression against the royal family.

secrets: He doubts the prophesied hero will be enough to stop the demonic army.

clocks.name: The Demon Vanguard Approaches
steps: Demonic scout squads are spotted near the edges of the Whispering Woods.
The main vanguard column establishes a fortified forward camp inside the forest.
Solaria's outer wall is besieged by the Demon vanguard's monstrous forces.

threads.title: Save Solaria from the Demon Vanguard
threads.stakes: The destruction of the human kingdom if the vanguard breaches the capital.

mysteries.question: Why did the summoning ritual pull me from my world?
mysteries.answer: The ritual targets high-speed soul transitions; the sudden momentum of the truck collision created the exact dimensional tear required.
clues: A summoning manual noting that 'rapid worldly departures yield the highest dimensional friction.'
Grand Mage Valerius remarking that you arrived with residual kinetic energy still sparking from your soul.

known_facts: You were hit by a truck in your past life.
You have just been summoned into a fantasy world as a hero.
A young princess and an old mage are waiting for you to stand up.

positions: The player is lying in the center of a glowing golden summoning circle.
Princess Elara is kneeling nearby, catching her breath.
Grand Mage Valerius is standing at the edge of the dais, staff raised.
opening.situation: You open your eyes on a glowing stone floor, the smell of burnt rubber still lingering in your mind, to find a beautiful princess gasping in relief at your arrival.

world.summary: After a sudden collision with a truck, you wake up in a fantasy summoning chamber as a destined hero. Princess Elara and Grand Mage Valerius welcome you, hoping your otherworldly cheat skill will save their kingdom from an impending demonic invasion.

character.name: Takuya
character.description: An ordinary teenager suddenly thrust into extraordinary circumstances, looking around with a mix of shock and confusion.
character.appearance: Slim build, black hair, wearing slightly scuffed casual school clothes that contrast sharply with the stone chamber.

traits.name: Otherworldly Traveler
traits.description: Immune to local soul-binding curses and mind-altering magic.

talents.name: Copycat Eye
talents.covers: any physical technique or magical spell you watch someone perform in your vicinity
talents.reason: An overpowered cheat skill granted during your transition between worlds.

powers.name: Cheat: Absolute Replication
limits: You must watch the spell or martial move being successfully performed.
Your current mana pool must be large enough to cast the replicated magic.

costs.text: A brief moment of mental strain when integrating a newly copied skill.

temperament.voice: Modern, slightly informal, trying to make sense of the world's status screens.

character.title: Summoned Hero

connections.name: Princess Elara
connections.note: The young princess who summoned you to save her home.

backstory: You were crossing the street on an ordinary afternoon when a roaring engine and blinding headlights ended your school days instantly.
Instead of darkness, your consciousness drifted through a void before assembling on a magical summoning dais in Solaria.
